verdict: Google ads went dark and leads have stalled — both are being fixed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 15 leads at a cost of $159.60 per lead, but the past week deteriorated sharply: Google Ads stopped delivering on 4 of the last 6 days, and you saw zero leads recorded across all channels from August 1–3. Meta continued running and held its ground, but at current volume it cannot compensate for Google's absence on its own. Separately, 90 opportunities are sitting in the pipeline with zero booked appointments, which points to an intake gap that is preventing leads from converting into jobs — this is being addressed directly alongside the Google outage. Restoring Google delivery and confirming intake coverage are the two actions in motion right now; once both are resolved you should see lead volume and booking activity recover toward prior levels.
